scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:api
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @nuttie/contracts build && pnpm --filter @nuttie/domain build && pnpm --filter @nuttie/design-tokens build && pnpm --filter @nuttie/ui build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @nuttie/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @nuttie/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @nuttie/design-tokens typecheck && pnpm --filter @nuttie/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @nuttie/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @nuttie/app typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nuttie/contracts build && pnpm --filter @nuttie/domain test && pnpm --filter @nuttie/api test && node tools/verify-web-export.test.mjs
